content.title: Hedge Funds Pile Into Health Stocks Leading Market in Rotation
content.summary: The S&P 500 Health Care Index is up 10% through Tuesday, outperforming the other 10 sectors in the benchmark for US stocks.  Eli Lilly & Co. has surged 29% to become the first health company with a $1 trillion valuation.  Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Inc., Merck & Co. and Biogen Inc. are all up at least 18% since the end of October.

content.title: FDA Decision Opens Bigger Market for Novartis’s Blockbuster Gene Therapy
content.summary: Zolgensma is only approved for infants with spinal muscular atrophy. Older people will be able to use a new version of the treatment, called Itvisma.
